skill_title: Occurrence Visualization (maps, depth/elevation profiles, env envelopes, trait space)
skill_description: PHASE 2 of the marine-eDNA meta-skill stack (PLAN-marine-edna-meta-skill.md). Standalone, realm-aware (marine | freshwater | terrestrial) publication-quality plotting of DwC-shaped occurrence tables: species occurrence maps (rnaturalearth basemap with maps::map() fallback, point subsampling), realm-routed environmental profiles (marine -> depth profiles; freshwater/terrestrial -> elevation/bioclim profiles via the same plotting code with the x-axis variable taken from run config), env envelope plots, optional trait-space plots, and multi-panel report figures with a captions manifest. Consumes any parquet/CSV with the minimal DwC columns scientificName, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, eventDate (PLAN §11.6) — e.g. plain obis-gbif-fetch output or edna-crosscheck enriched.parquet. Renderer pinned to R (ggplot2 + sf + rnaturalearth, arrow for parquet).
input_contract: PLAN-marine-edna-meta-skill.md §11.6 — standalone DwC minimal columns (scientificName, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, eventDate); env/trait columns optional
warnings: r-rnaturalearthhires not packaged on conda-forge — high-res basemap layer unavailable via pixi; skill uses rnaturalearthdata (medium, 1:50m) as baseline with maps::map() fallback, mirroring the geocurate_inventory.R fallback pattern
